title: Manda's Rhythm & Dance
specs: Classes taught by certified instructors including Acrobatic Arts certified instructors.
Shoe requirements vary by class, e.g. pink leather ballet shoes for girls, black leather ballet shoes for boys, tap shoes, jazz boots, clean tennis shoes for hip-hop.
Dress codes include leotards, tights, hair in bun or braid for ballet and lyrical, biketard or leotard with shorts for acro, and appropriate attire for toddlers.
Acro 1 for ages 6-9, Acro 2 for ages 10 and up, Acro 3 by instructor approval only.

options.name: Wedding Lessons
options.detail: Dance lessons for couples to prepare their first dance, including waltz and personalized style.

options.name: Children's Dance Classes
options.detail: Dance classes teaching ballet, jazz, tap, lyrical, and pom-poms with focus on technique and performance.

options.name: Toddler & Preschool Dance Classes
options.detail: Hip-Hop, Creative Movement, Jazz, and Acro classes for toddlers and preschoolers with age-appropriate music and activities.

options.name: Acro & Tumbling Classes
options.detail: Classes focusing on flexibility, tumbling skills, handstands, cartwheels, and strength training with a patented curriculum.

blurb: Manda's Rhythm & Dance offers dance classes for children and toddlers including ballet, jazz, tap, lyrical, hip-hop, creative movement, and acro & tumbling. They also provide wedding dance lessons tailored to the couple's song and style. Classes focus on technique, performance skills, and fun.
